children: Argentina’s Consumer Confidence Index rose 0.81% month over month to 41.52 points in October 2026.
By region, the index increased 6.77% in the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires, while declining 0.14% in Greater Buenos Aires and 0.25% in the rest of the country.
The Interior recorded the highest index level at 46.00 points, while GBA had the lowest at 39.49 points.
By income group, confidence among high-income households rose 1.99%, while it fell 1.30% among low-income households.
The index stood at 41.76 points for high-income households, compared with 40.75 points for low-income households.
Among the subindices, Durable Goods and Real Estate climbed 8.77%, while Personal Situation fell 2.59% and Macroeconomic Situation declined 1.57%.
Meanwhile, Present Conditions improved 5.88%, while Future Expectations decreased 2.61%.

title: Argentina’s Consumer Confidence Rises in October
